title: Near-balanced bit blocks for conditional κ = 1.3001411e-5
body:
Near-balanced dimensions **(33,31,34)** admit two contiguous A1 blocks in one compatible rational basis. Combining them with Rohan Arun's #25 A5 block, icekylinx's #24 producer, and Zhihao Chen's #21/#23 complex and semantic interfaces gives

$$T(n)=O(n(\log n)^{1-\kappa}),\qquad \kappa=\frac{13001411}{10^{12}}=1.3001411\times10^{-5}>2^{-17}.$$

This is approximately **6.04% above #28's 1.2260937e-5 witness** in asymptotic exponent saving. **Concurrent result:** #29 appeared during the final publication check with κ=1.5536e-5, which exceeds this witness. This draft preserves the independently developed near-balanced construction; it does not claim the current leading bound. This is a conditional asymptotic bound, not a practical runtime claim.

### New geometric blocks

The paired A1 profile is **`33, 1, 1, 31, 1, 34648`**. A lower-bidiagonal corner gives the first width-33 block. After two scalar pivots, exact Schur cancellation exposes the second width-31 block. The proof keeps the pivots consecutive and equally ordered in one basis, with no uncharged gathering or reversal.

The inner labels `R=C=[I,0,I]` admit simultaneous permutation completions. Exact bipartite-tree witnesses certify the A5 restrictions; the width-29 A5 block specializes #25's cancellation. All remaining ordinary and A3 corners are justified in the same irreducible rational family. Explicit rational projector witnesses supplement the general nonvanishing argument.

All three bit producers are rebuilt at the new dimensions. At h=34, positive enlargement permits 3706 final matches, 68 more than the initial envelope matching; each final match passes the retained containment and strict event-order checks.

### Compatible assembly

The bit saving is **52007/4000000000 = 1.300175e-5**, with exact moment gap greater than **1e-13**. The new bit dimension is 34782 and maximum child 34720. Bit halving depth/wire exponent are 389/43; the unchanged complex values are 544/41. The product row stock has coefficient 39031 and degree **80000**.

The complex saving remains 18e-6, beta=1/4, and the semantic guard remains C1=1. The assembly uses headroom 1e-8 and recomputes all **47 strict constraints and seven margins**. The final absorption gap exceeds **5e-13**.

### Review and validation

- Fresh reconstruction of all three selected scalar graphs, coefficients, positive labels, matchings and histograms passed, comparing complete records exactly.
- The exact certificate, common-basis and rational projector controls passed. Six negative controls reject the next bit grid point, omitting either new block contribution, the old guard, old exposures and an unsupported 2^-16 target.
- An independent mathematical audit checked the common-basis proof, ordered A1 blocks, A5/A3 compatibility and recomputed assembly without a blocking finding.
- The generated proof patch passes `git apply --check` against the pinned PR23 manuscript.
- **Draft:** the full repository rerun and final independent Standards/Spec reviews of this integrated snapshot are in progress. Their results will be recorded before marking ready.

Reproduce with `make near-balanced-producer near-balanced-certificate` and `make verify`. No PDF is created.

This branch extends #27 commit `c297233e788a23e9833ad1ee07fc8517accd0f42`; commit `01c9e70` isolates this construction. The main-branch diff includes pending predecessors. Historical certificates, source pins and existing PRs are preserved. The written proof retains the inherited analytic, routing, precision, compiler and tape hypotheses. Exact executable checks are not formal verification of the complete multiplication theorem. No global-optimality claim is made.
